Caption: 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2122fd56-f998-40f6-9e42-bd8b817f95a6/image.png?t=1739410654)
Follow image link: (https://go.innovatingwithai.com/consultancy-neuron-primary)
Caption: 

Welcome, humans. 

**This is wild: **while Apple abandoned its long-rumored Apple Car project awhile back (_boooo_), it now looks to be developing a [humanoid robot](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/12/apple-is-reportedly-exploring-humanoid-robots/) (_wooo!)_. They already produced a framework [called EMOTION](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/emotion-expressive-motion) to help robots, _take a guess_, understand human [social cues and respond with appropriate gestures](https://youtu.be/npC6Zl6pvzk?feature=shared) ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.23234)). 

_Uhhh, could us humans ALSO get a copy of that? Asking for a friend… _

Not only that, Apple has a bunch of other robotics ideas in development, like this [research paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.12493) exploring a robot version of the [Pixar Lamp](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/08/apples-new-research-robot-takes-a-page-from-pixars-playbook/). Another project in the works is a tabletop robot sorta like an [iPad on wheels](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2024-08-25/apple-plans-tabletop-robot-while-exploring-mobile-bots-and-humanoid-machines-m09kawex).

Idk about you, but we want our future Apple bots to be able to do what Carnegie Mellon and NVIDIA researchers’ new [ASAP framework](https://agile.human2humanoid.com/) can do ([paper](https://agile.human2humanoid.com/static/asap.pdf)): 

Youtube: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills (https://youtu.be/tu7LSNYWDTs?feature=shared)

Their Unitree G1 robot nails Kobe's fadeaway jumper, recreates LeBron's “Silencer” celebration (complete with the single-leg landing!), and even pulls off Ronaldo's signature 180° celebration jump. _Imagine buying a bot to play basketball with. It’d almost be like having real friends! _

**Fun fact:** They broke two robots during training. _But as they say, no pain, no gain… _

**Here’s what you need to know about AI today:**

* Sam announced “GPT 4.5” in a few weeks, “GPT 5” in a few months. 

* Anthropic’s new model to arrive “in the coming weeks.”

* EU planned $200B+ AI investment with chip factories.

* Study found ChatGPT power use could be 10x lower than estimated.

**Advertise in The Neuron here.** (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfng1Qz3wGLc_-f9goa1TQgnGE_rehbW55Gx5VaEYIhn4OueQ/viewform)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8725d956-e5e7-4b68-90a6-08a1aaebeacf/Neuron-Page-Splitters3.png)
Caption: 

# Sam just released the OpenAI roadmap for the next few months… here’s what it means for YOU. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e6d9e645-b695-4495-8308-c0e713ae01d6/Screenshot_2025-02-12_at_2.26.33_PM_1.png?t=1739411313)
Follow image link: (https://x.com/sama/status/1889755723078443244)
Caption: 

You might not remember this, but there used to be a time when ChatGPT was just..._ChatGPT. _No model picker, no settings to fiddle with, just pure AI magic.

Well, OpenAI is FINALLY fixing the confusing mess of GPT models—and making GPT-5 free(_ish_).

**In a **[**surprise announcement**](https://x.com/sama/status/1889755723078443244)**, Sam revealed OpenAI's detailed roadmap for GPT-4.5 (Orion) and GPT-5:**

* GPT-4.5 (Orion) will arrive in a few “_weeks_” as the last “traditional” model. 

* GPT-5 will follow in a few “_months”,_ and will include o3 on top of it.

* Separately, [OpenAI announced](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/1889822643676913977) o1 and o3 mini now support files + images. 

The interesting thing here is how OpenAI is simplifying by unifying _everything_—GPT-5 will come fully equipped with voice chat, image creation, search, and [Deep Research](https://openai.com/index/introducing-deep-research/) in one seamless interface. 

**Here's what this means for **_**you:**_ No more juggling between different models or tools—just tell GPT-5 what you want to do, and it'll handle the rest.

* Want a weather update? Instant answer. 

* Building a website? It'll methodically write and test the code.

* Need research help? It'll search the web and cite sources.

GPT will technically do all of this now…but it takes some *_~finesse~* _to pull off.

**Now, the pricing shakeup is **_**even more interesting**_**:**

* Free: Unlimited use of GPT-5 at “standard intelligence.”

* Plus users: “higher intelligence” version.

* Pro users: “_even higher”_ intelligence—_we talking AGI here, Sam? _

**But wait, there's more. **Sam also had [good news for Deep Research](https://x.com/sama/status/1889679679696806103)—plus and free users [will get access to it](https://venturebeat.com/ai/openai-ceo-sam-altman-shares-plans-to-bring-o3-deep-research-agent-to-free-and-chatgpt-plus-users/):

* **Plus**: 10 searches/month (scaling up over time).

* **Free**: 2 searches/month.

* Pay-as-you-go option planned, too. 

Since Deep Research was reserved for the Pro level of ChatGPT, many of you probably haven’t used it yet—but now that it’s opening up, we’ll share some advice on how to use it in our “Prompt Tip of the Day” below. 

**Our take:** OpenAI is finally admitting what we've all been thinking—their product lineup got _waaaay too complicated_. 

Using ChatGPT lately feels like playing a slot machine—you keep pulling different levers (GPT-4o, GPT-4o _with scheduled tasks, _o1, o3-mini, o3-mini-_high_), hoping you'll hit the jackpot with the right combination. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4e403932-9be1-49c5-86af-fc00bad7eb5a/Screenshot_2025-02-12_at_7.28.41_PM_1.png?t=1739417355)
Caption: Just look at this mess.

_Fun fact: _[_Three Mile Island_](https://www.nrc.gov/reading-rm/doc-collections/fact-sheets/3mile-isle.html)_’s near-miss disaster happened because of _[_confusing controls_](https://medium.com/@ChangeistheonlyConstant/user-experience-and-three-mile-island-accident-783344597213)_—user friendly tech saves lives! _

After years of increasing complexity, making GPT-5 both free _and_ simpler is an OBVIOUS play to make AI more mainstream. _We’ll see if it works! _

  * This is a big deal if true, because [another report](https://www.rand.org/pubs/research_reports/RRA3572-1.html) found AI data centers could need 68GW, or [nearly the entire power capacity of California](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/11/chatgpt-may-not-be-as-power-hungry-as-once-assumed/) from 2022, in only two years time.

* [The EU](https://www.euronews.com/next/2025/02/11/eu-to-mobilise-200-billion-for-ai-investment) will spend $200B+ on AI, with $20B+ specifically for five new AI “gigafactories” that will each use 100K AI chips from the last generation. 

* [PwC](https://www.pwc.com/us/en/tech-effect/ai-analytics/ai-agents.html) said over 79% of its 75K US employees actively use GenAI tools in their daily work, with an average of 26% of people using AI at least once per day.
